== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Navigators are members of a specialized [[Guild]] responsible for maritime travel across the [[Aion Sea]]. Because their vessels are essential for any business conducted on or through these waters, passage on a Navigator’s ship{{!}}Navigator ship is considered an extremely valuable commodity. [[The Guild]] is known for being highly secretive, often protecting its information more strictly than the [[Champions]]. Their headquarters, located in the Capital, is a massive structure constructed from the remains of old ships. A Navigator's primary tool is their [[Vessel]], a unique, Awakened ship that functions as a one-of-a-kind object. These ships are typically small, requiring only a minimal crew and a captain who is [[Soulbound]] to the craft. This spiritual connection allows the Navigator to control the ship as an extension of their own body. Creating a [[Vessel]] is a complex process that involves [[Awakening]] the entire ship and integrating parts of an Elder or a [[Kameira]] into its construction. While most [[Navigator ships]] can be launched without their captain, they cannot be sailed effectively without one. Individual Navigators vary; some, like [[Cheska Bennett]], lead the [[Guild]], while others, such as Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten, operate independently or under contract. Navigators are often identified by their specific attire, such as long coats, and may possess unique skills like specialized whistling. While they are essential for deep-sea exploration, the fleet can be subject to various pressures, including [[Imperial]] debts or conflicts with other groups like the [[Consultants]].}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Navigators are a group that possesses their own ships and guard their secrets even more fiercely than the [[Champions]]. During an excursion with Naberius Clayborn{{!}}Naberius and [[Tristania]], one such Navigator accompanied them. While these individuals frequently undertake officially sanctioned missions, a Navigator was eventually seen approaching a group while adorned with the Emperor's crown and an [[Awakened sword]].}}
